name: SAP Business Accelerator Hub Sandbox (Community)
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted SAP Business Accelerator Hub API mock and testing sandbox with OpenAPI/EDMX mock endpoints, generated operation tests, catalog version tracking and request inspection; no software quota or expiry published.
watch_out: Requires your own Windows/macOS/Linux compute and storage; SAP Business Accelerator Hub credentials or API keys may be required to retrieve restricted specifications. Optional external AI providers and infrastructure may cost extra. Set ADMIN_KEY, restrict network access and review proxied traffic before public deployment. Independent project, not affiliated with SAP.
